title: Pointer Overflow in Godot 4.6 (Custom Build)
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: Godot 4.6 [1e9d0ff] (Custom Build) - Not reproducible in any other version as far as I know ### System information Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3/ANGLE (Compatibility) - ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) HD Graphics 5500 (0x00001616) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-20.19.15.5171) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-5005U CPU @ 2.00GHz (4 threads) - 7.92 GiB memory ### Issue description I was compiling Godot via MinGW (MSYS2) for something I added to `core/version.h`. It has nothing to do with this as the issue was encountered in the `scene\main\multiplayer_peer.cpp`. The issue I got: ```scene\main\multiplayer_peer.cpp: In member function 'virtual Error MultiplayerPeerExtension::put_packet(const uint8_t*, int)': scene\main\multiplayer_peer.cpp:161:23: warning: 'void* memcpy(void*, const void*, size_t)' pointer overflow between offset 0 and size [-2147483648, -1] [-Warray-bounds=] 161 | memcpy(a.ptrw(), p_buffer, p_buffer_size); | ``` Screenshot: ### Steps to reproduce - Install MinGW via MSYS2. - Get the main repo with commit [1e9d0ff] - Use the following scons command: `scons platform=windows tools=yes target=editor use_scu=yes cache_dir=E:\Projects\GDBuildCache use_mingw=yes -j3` - Have Godot compile, you should encounter it at 61% after `scene\main\node.cpp` is compiled (I got after this) - That's it! ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A (Check steps to reproduce instead)
